events.name: Birthday Car
events.description: A boxy SUV pulls up right behind your birthday cake, you lean out of the driver's window, blow out every candle in one breath, and the picture turns black and white.

events.name: Diwali Fireworks Transition
events.description: You sweep a sheer red dupatta across the lens under a blue sky, the day whips into night, and you spin in a red and gold lehenga under golden Diwali fireworks, then look back over your shoulder. Or your pet does.

events.name: Dog Bohemian Rhapsody
events.description: Your dog or cat sits at a black grand piano on a dark stadium stage and sings Bohemian Rhapsody into the microphone, eyes shut, until the camera is right in its face and it opens its eyes at you. Or you do.

events.name: Dog Couple Dance
events.description: One of you hops and dances by the bed while the other stands up filming it on a phone, kicking along: two pets, the two of you, or you and your pet.

events.name: Dog Elevator Prank
events.description: A giant dog walks upright beside you to the lift, slaps the back of your neck, presses the button, then boots you into the lift with a hind paw and throws your sneakers in after you. Your pet can play the dog.
